entities.name: Jerome Murphy-O'Connor
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jerome Murphy-O'Connor was an Irish Dominican priest, a leading authority on St. Paul, and a Professor of New Testament at the École Biblique in Jerusalem, a position that he held from 1967 until his death.
